title: Arcade Tool Execution
description: Schema for an Arcade tool execution request/response. Tool executions are the unit of work performed by the Arcade Engine on behalf of a user_id with user-scoped authorization.

tool_name.description: Fully qualified tool name (Toolkit.Name@version) to execute.

user_id.description: Stable identifier of the end-user whose authorization tokens will be used. Required for user-scoped tool calls.

input.description: Input arguments conforming to the tool's input JSON Schema.

run_at.description: Optional future time at which the tool should be executed. When set, the call is converted into a scheduled tool execution.

execution_id.description: Server-assigned identifier of the execution attempt (response field).

output.description: Tool output. Present when status is completed.

error.description: Error details when status is failed.
